title: A Personal Assistant AI for a UK Real Estate Agency
subtitle: Ask a plain question, get your schedule back, no tabs, no manual scanning
blurb: Built an n8n agent for a UK real estate agency that answers a plain-language question like "What's on my calendar tomorrow?" by pulling live data from Google Calendar and replying with a clean daily summary.
result: Replaced manually opening and scanning a calendar with a single question that returns a clean daily summary

meta.solutions: n8n, Google Calendar Integration, Natural-Language Scheduling

whoFor: Agents who wanted to check tomorrow's schedule without opening five tabs or manually scanning a calendar grid every morning.
challengeIntro: Checking the next day's schedule meant opening a calendar app and manually scanning a grid of meetings, every single morning.
challengePoints: No quick way to get a schedule summary without opening the full calendar view
Understanding tomorrow's plan meant manually parsing a grid of meetings
No natural-language way to ask a simple scheduling question
builtIntro: Built in n8n: an AI agent reads a plain question like "What's on my calendar tomorrow?", understands the date context, pulls the relevant data from Google Calendar, and replies with a clean daily summary.
builtPoints: Clean daily summary reply, no manual scanning
builtOutro: One clear trigger, a few connected steps, and an AI layer that does the thinking in between: small automations like this save hours every week, and that adds up fast across a team.
